title: A relationship pointing at a record the export does not contain
intent: An edge file naming a deal that is not in the deals export is ordinary: exports are taken at different moments, and a relationship can outlive one of its ends. The row feeds no record of its own, so it is set aside rather than delivered, and the relationship ledger says why. A package check that demanded a corroborator for every isolation reason, and did not know the association reasons, refused the whole migration instead — the run aborted after writing the package.
